WITH joined AS (
  SELECT sc.*, s.healtheval
  FROM scanconservation sc
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
),
group_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    healtheval,
    COUNT(*) as group_count
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY healtheval
),
overall_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(group_count) as total
  FROM group_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    gc.healtheval,
    gc.group_count,
    ot.total,
    CAST(gc.group_count AS REAL) / CAST(ot.total AS REAL) as share
  FROM group_counts gc
  CROSS JOIN overall_total ot
  WHERE ot.total IS NOT NULL
),
average_share_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM with_shares
),
filtered_rows AS (
  SELECT 
    ws.group_count,
    ws.share,
    (ws.share - asc.avg_share) as share_diff
  FROM with_shares ws
  CROSS JOIN average_share_calc asc
  WHERE asc.avg_share IS NOT NULL
    AND ws.share > asc.avg_share
)
SELECT 
  AVG(group_count) as avg_group_count,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(share_diff) as avg_share_diff
FROM filtered_rows
